context: Extend _project/scripts/todo_db_shadow.py and its tests. Use the locked BenchBox package command for local scratch imports and hosted read-only snapshots. Keep migration reports and rollback artifacts outside the repository unless an explicit ADR says otherwise.
description: Prepare the existing BenchBox shadow migration tooling for the canonical package cutover. Remove hardcoded developer-machine paths and make the shadow tool invoke the locked todo-db package from the BenchBox project environment. Preserve fail-closed protections for protected databases, existing targets, empty sources, zero-item imports, identity mismatches, and unredacted credentials. This item owns migration tooling only; it does not implement tracker behavior. It is blocked on the canonical package release.

anti_patterns.dont: Hardcode /Users/joe/Developer/todo-db or rely on a sibling checkout
anti_patterns.instead: Invoke the package from BenchBox's locked uv environment
anti_patterns.why: Fresh clones and CI cannot reproduce that path

anti_patterns.dont: Run migration against the live target before a fresh scratch rehearsal passes
anti_patterns.instead: Require a non-empty scratch target, normalized parity, and audit verification first
anti_patterns.why: The migration is destructive and previous export/import formats have diverged

anti_patterns.dont: Treat a passed item-count comparison as full parity
anti_patterns.instead: Compare all supported tables and semantic fields with explicit expected differences
anti_patterns.why: Findings, dependencies, scope, audit, and identity can still be lost

preserves.behavior: Bind the destination to project_id benchbox and the canonical BenchBox repository identity
Keep lossless versioned snapshots and reports off-repository and redact credentials
Never report a successful zero-item or empty-source migration
Never restore over a protected or existing target
Use a leased maintenance freeze for the full snapshot-to-restore window; claim checks alone are insufficient
